rationale.reason: Harbour and navigation-waterway structures match the listed water-transport facilities; operating port services and unrelated waterworks are separate.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability
Applies to an actual configured harbour or navigation waterway civil entity constructed and accepted at a defined site: harbour basins/channels, breakwaters, quays/piers/jetties/docks/wharves, river/canal works for water transport, and integral locks, sluices/floodgates, lifts, dry docks, slipways or barrages with declared waterway function. The category requires sediment-route control, alternative waterborne structures, actual navigation geometry and hydromechanical installation that material or vessel-manufacturing PCRs do not provide. [un-cpc3-waterworks-2025]

The default foreground is initial construction and handover. Select the real project route and add all its actual atomic exchanges. A complete piled pier, capital-dredged navigation channel or navigation lock is a configured entity with its own acceptance schedule; no single example is imposed on the category. Independent construction and engineering services, raw materials, dredger/platform manufacture, vessel operation/repair, water-supply aqueducts/pipelines, irrigation/flood-control works and reservoir dams as independent primary entities are excluded. Multi-purpose works must separate functions and disclose shared construction. No full-life or complete cradle-to-gate claim is established by this site module.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Accepted harbour/navigation-waterway entities and their integral water-transport civil/hydromechanical facilities
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Independent water supply, irrigation/flood control or reservoir dam; buildings; material/equipment manufacture; vessel or port operational services
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Complete configured constructed entity at the stated site, accepted for its declared use; not loose construction materials or a generic construction service

boundary_limitations: Initial construction and accepted handover only; upstream supply, actual transport, capital attribution and later lifecycle stages are separately scoped.
Actual alternate structures, sluice/floodgate/lift/dry-dock systems, materials and process variants require additional specific exchanges before a full-project completeness claim.
No defaults for facility mass, geometry, mixture, lifetime, load, fuel factor, sediment density/bulking/moisture or approval.
unresolved_evidence: Actual project geometry/acceptance, physical lot amounts, same-state conversions, equipment activity/reuse shares and substance-specific releases are dataset-production requirements, not invented here.
Noise/underwater vibration, hydrodynamics, habitat/land-use impacts and later-stage inventories require separate evidence and assessment.

No source-backed universal amount ranges exist for these project-specific construction exchanges; important-flow range warnings remain explicit. Quantities and uncertainties must come from actual lot/project records.
Public Portland cement identity has a descriptive binder name/state and Mass property but anomalous tile classification; retain source applicability and scientific identity review before publication.
